episodes.title: Horseback Riding in American Falls
episodes.summary: B. takes Jan on a trip, but as night looms and they're still not back, the Brobergs grow worried.

episodes.title: The Mission
episodes.summary: The Brobergs call in the FBI to search for Jan; Jan is tasked with a disturbing responsibility.

episodes.title: The Gift of Tongues
episodes.summary: As B. deepens his bonds with the Broberg family, Bob starts to feel like he's losing control.

episodes.title: Articles of Faith
episodes.summary: The Brobergs fight to restore a sense of normalcy as they prepare to face B. in court.

episodes.title: The Bitter Cup
episodes.summary: As the Brobergs' marriage is thrown into jeopardy, B. strengthens his sinister hold over Jan.

episodes.title: Son of Perdition
episodes.summary: In Jackson Hole, Jan is stressed by the mission's demands; Bob and Mary Ann try to bring her home.

episodes.title: The Great Deceiver
episodes.summary: Jan goes missing again and the FBI's hands are tied, but the Brobergs press on in their search for answers; the case takes a heavy toll on Pete as he digs deeper into B.'s past; Jan learns to blend in a strange new environment.

episodes.title: Outer Darkness
episodes.summary: Mary Ann prepares for a high-stakes showdown; worn down by fear, Jan nears her breaking point.

episodes.title: Revelation
episodes.summary: With Jan home, Bob and Mary Ann take steps toward healing, but as her 16th birthday approaches and the mission reaches its do-or-die moment, Jan prepares for the worst.
